Basics

White fish spread

Halpástétom

6 months+ Sound idea 25 min 2 portions

From 6 months. If fish is new, try the first taste in the morning on a well day, and once it is tolerated keep offering fish a few times a week.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 60 g boneless white fish (pollock, cod, or haddock; not shark, swordfish, marlin, carp, or smoked fish)
  • 80 g potato (peeled and cooked soft)
  • 1 tsp rapeseed or olive oil (stirred in at the end)

Allergens

fish

Method

  1. Check the fillet and remove every bone.
  2. Poach or steam it until it flakes and is opaque all through.
  3. Mash it with the cooked potato and the oil.
  4. Thin with a little cooking water if needed.
  5. Cool quickly.
  6. Serve, or freeze in a small pot, and do not use smoked fish.

Sound idea

Smoked fish is salty and is not the same as a fresh cooked fillet.

Blend cooked boneless white fish with potato and oil. Leave out smoked fish, shark, swordfish, marlin, and carp.
